name: Fail2ban
tagline: A daemon to ban hosts that cause multiple authentication errors.
description: Fail2ban is a daemon to ban hosts that cause multiple authentication errors.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/fail2ban:1.1.0@sha256:6d04e983661436f0080675a5b8cbecf07e00126266edd12b5a8c1fa49c8ecec0
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      VERBOSITY: ''
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/var/log:ro
        target: /var/log:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/airsonic:ro
        target: /remotelogs/airsonic:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/apache2:ro
        target: /remotelogs/apache2:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/authelia:ro
        target: /remotelogs/authelia:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/emby:ro
        target: /remotelogs/emby:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/filebrowser:ro
        target: /remotelogs/filebrowser:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/homeassistant:ro
        target: /remotelogs/homeassistant:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/lighttpd:ro
        target: /remotelogs/lighttpd:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/nextcloud:ro
        target: /remotelogs/nextcloud:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/nginx:ro
        target: /remotelogs/nginx:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/overseerr:ro
        target: /remotelogs/overseerr:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/unificontroller:ro
        target: /remotelogs/unificontroller:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/remotelogs/vaultwarden:ro
        target: /remotelogs/vaultwarden:ro
